description:
We are an innovative brand specializing in anime-themed home furnishings, covering over 20 popular IPs such as *One Piece* and *Dragon Ball*. Utilizing high-density weaving and environmentally friendly dyeing, our products boast high fidelity, durability, and long-lasting colors. They serve as both a status symbol for anime fans and a core element for low-cost home makeovers, precisely targeting the global anime and home fashion enthusiast population aged 16-45.

What sets us apart:

Scenario-based solutions: Providing "carpets + related merchandise + makeover guides," with a 35% user repurchase rate, exceeding the industry average by 18%;

Supply chain guarantee: Direct supply from our own factory, ultra-fast shipping, rapid after-sales response, and worry-free promotion;

High social media buzz: Products inherently carry the hashtag "#Anime+HomeMakeover," accumulating over 5 million impressions across three platforms, easily generating viral spread.

How Affiliate Members Earn Revenue

Tiered Commission: Base commission of 10%, increasing in tiers after reaching certain sales targets; top affiliates can negotiate up to 20% exclusive commission.

Extra Rewards: Monthly "Promotion Star" award of $500-$2000.

Long-Term Revenue: Exclusive discount code tracking for 30 days, cross-platform data integration, unified settlement of revenue from multiple accounts.

Transparent Settlement: Monthly reports generated, real-time data monitoring, flexible settlement via PayPal/bank transfer, arrival within 3 business days.

How to Promote Us

Content Direction: Scene transformation (e.g., "100 Yuan Transformation of a 2D Rental Apartment"), product testing (e.g., "Carpet Durability Test"), trending meme interaction (e.g., "Carpet Reveals Anime Attributes").

Platform Strategy: 15-30 second trending meme videos on TikTok; Reels scene aesthetics + image and text guides on Instagram; Pinterest practical cleaning/styling tips.

Promotion Tools: High-definition material packages, custom discount codes, regularly updated new/holiday materials.

Partnership Support: Dedicated manager for 1-on-1 support; affiliates with 100,000+ followers can apply for customized review packages.

Join us and bring the "authentic anime and manga culture" to anime fans worldwide, easily monetizing your traffic! Apply now and enjoy a starting commission rate of 10% for your first month!
payout_period: Commission payment is made on the first day of the following month
